readiness_assessment.owner_invariant: One immutable assessment identity retains its exact rule revision, as-of input snapshot, and findings.
readiness_assessment.implementation: ReadinessAssessment records one ReadinessAssessmentRecorded fact, validates tenant/program/assessment identity and revision 1, and retains immutable snapshot references. ProgramReadiness separately owns the latest-assessment pointer and decision admission.

data_flow.owner_invariant: One tenant inventory identity has one record kind; each flow revision validates endpoints, carried asset scope, encryption or approved exception for the highest carried classification, and nondecreasing effective date.
data_flow.implementation: DataFlow uses tenant plus caller ID through TechnologyInventoryStreams.Address, tracks foreign-kind sentinels, validates normalized business content, and appends revision facts with expected revision. InventoryRetryTests exercise exact retry across revisions.

information_asset.owner_invariant: One tenant inventory identity has one record kind and one revisioned classification, retention, owner, and lifecycle record.
information_asset.implementation: InformationAsset uses the shared technology-inventory address with foreign-kind sentinels, validates normalized content, and appends expected-revision facts. InventoryRetryTests exercise original registration retry after later revision; impact tests cover classification changes.

assessment_boundary.instructions: Does an immutable assessment with its own assessment identity and exact input/rule snapshot justify a separate ReadinessAssessment owner from the ProgramReadiness governor that tracks only latest adoption and decision admission?

criteria.true: The assessment snapshot and findings are an immutable result with their own identity; ProgramReadiness has a separate compact coordination invariant.
criteria.false: Assessment content and latest-adoption coordination must be mutated atomically by the same owner.

data_flow_boundary.instructions: Do the tenant-scoped flow identity and flow-specific endpoint, carried-asset, encryption and effective-date rules justify DataFlow as a distinct business owner?

criteria.true: A flow is independently identified and revised under its own content rules.
criteria.false: The flow has no independent lifecycle and must be owned atomically with another inventory record.

information_asset_boundary.instructions: Do the tenant-scoped identity and revisioned classification, retention, owner and lifecycle rules justify InformationAsset as a distinct business owner?

criteria.true: An asset is independently identified and revised under its own content rules.
criteria.false: An asset has no independent lifecycle and must be owned atomically with another inventory record.
